speaker: margery_pell
text: An ordinary stair. I have my line, and it is only that. I am not making you a Whit Monday of a Wednesday.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou playedst, the flag comes down, and the yard goes home. That is a playing day. Do not dress it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not dress it. Two Gentlemen, and nothing in it that asks a crowd to be a crowd.

speaker: margery_pell
text: Then we are done. The stair is clear enough. Go home while it is.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Go home, Will. Thou hast the look of a man who left a page upstairs on purpose.
